source.content: @isTest private class PrivateCorpusFlowInterviewTypeTest { @isTest static void flowInterviewTypeIsAvailable() { Flow.Interview interview = Flow.Interview.createInterview('LocalFlow', new Map<String,Object>{ 'answer' => 42 }); System.assertNotEquals(null, interview); } }
